description: Start a run. Returns run_id, the task text, the mode and the rules. `model` is your own model id (testimony, at most 64 chars). The only way to answer is to build Vera's structure and call emit; plain text is discarded.
name: begin

description: Find a corpus unit by exact surface (no substring search). tier: RUN | WORD | CHAR | any. Returns n, every sentence id, and the first 5 sentences.
name: lookup

description: Read one corpus sentence by id, with the units it holds in each tier.
name: read_sentence

description: Add a unit to the pool. kind=record: text must be exactly a unit of `tier` (RUN|WORD|CHAR). kind=constructed: your own word, marked as yours, only if the mode allows it (1-8 chars, not a corpus unit). Returns the uid.
name: add

description: Open a cross of arm length L (prose 1-5, code 1-8). In a prose cross the innermost seat of each arm holds the foundation particle (の に で と を が) and is never yours. depth is for code lines only.
name: open_cross

description: Seat a unit. seat = 'centre' or '<arm>:<k>' (k=0 is the outer end), or a bare arm such as '+x' for the innermost empty seat of that arm.
name: seat

description: Seat several units on one arm IN THE ORDER THEY ARE READ (prose: outer to inner, ending next to the particle; code: inner to outer).
name: seat_run

description: SPAN WEAVING in one call. Give a corpus sentence id you have read (read_sentence), a tier (RUN|WORD|CHAR) and the stretch you want, from the unit `first` to the unit `last` (both included), each written exactly as read_sentence lists that unit for the tier (plain text, no quotation marks; `last` is searched from `first` on). The loom makes record units for exactly those units and builds the chain of crosses whose read-out is that stretch WORD FOR WORD, linked at the end of the thread: a unit followed by one of の に で と を が goes on that particle's arm of the cross whose centre is the very next unit; units that touch each other become one-unit crosses in order; a unit followed by は is a topic centre. If the stretch is not expressible (a word the loom cannot write between two units, such as という or として, or a chain like AのBのC that needs one unit as both a centre and an arm unit) it is refused as span_inexpressible and nothing changes; weave a smaller stretch. Returns the crosses and seats it made and the text of the stretch (not the rest of the sentence). Record units only; one operation. Use `drop` to throw a cross away.
name: weave_span

description: Take a unit off a seat; it goes back to the pool.
name: unseat

description: Exchange two data seats of one cross; either may be empty (then it is a move).
name: swap

description: Grow a cross to arm length L2 by adding empty outer seats to every arm.
name: extend

description: Mark a prose cross as a topic: は is read right after its centre word.
name: topic

description: Set the indentation depth (0-8) of a code cross.
name: set_depth

description: Add a cross to the thread at position pos (default: the end). Crosses are read in thread order.
name: link

description: Remove a cross from the thread; its units stay seated.
name: unlink

description: Throw a whole cross away: the cross and the units seated in it are removed (they are gone, not returned to the pool), and the cross leaves the thread if it was linked. One operation.
name: drop

description: Dry run of emit: returns the text the thread reads as, the annotated segments, every refusal emit would give, and the stability of each cross. Nothing closes. `notes` may list structural observations (CONFLICT, UNANCHORED, NO_RECORD, QUESTION_ECHO: a unit that is a word of the question); they never block.
name: read

description: Fix the output: the text the thread reads as. Refused with every reason if the structure is not sound (unstable cross, unlinked cross, empty centre, no_evidence, ...). A successful emit may carry `notes` (CONFLICT, UNANCHORED, NO_RECORD, QUESTION_ECHO: a unit that is a word of the question); they never block.
name: emit

description: Close the run without an output. type: no_record | cannot_weave | unknown.
name: abstain

description: The thread, the crosses and their seats, the pool, the counters and the caps.
name: status
